content: A ɓavala Yasu da tǝvuk Bilatus Gwumn kǝ takara lav
Pǝrta kǝdl, daghan zikzikan na kǝ zil kǝsakh zǝ malanakhe ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ dlam, ka ɗayakavu itar dzanak kǝ kǝɗ Yasu.
Ka ngwuɗana itar, bo itar ǝn tǝvuk, ɓala itar da vak Bilatus Gwumn.
A kǝɗga Yakhud ad ghǝr sar ǝn tǝ dǝva dǝ khǝrt ghǝr sar

Vazga kǝ Yakhud dadake sukwdu Yasu kwarne a tǝkavarna lav ǝmtsa kǝ Yasu, ka bazala rǝv tsin dǝ dǝge a mangin. Ka sa da vak zikzikan na kǝ zil kǝsakh zǝ malanakh ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ dlam, guyatǝrnǝf ad kwaɓ dawan kulkhǝkǝrɗǝn.
Ni, “A manga ka khaip, kǝ sukwdu dadake kwal dǝ ghaz.” Ka nǝv itar, “Uɗa ɗangwundi? Ya ɗangwa yan.”
Ka ɗiyars ad kwaɓ dawanen ǝn Fǝta Yazhigǝl, sawala, dakavala, ka khǝrtgan ad ghǝrsar.
Ka khutsanǝf zikzikan na kǝ zil kǝsakhen ad kwaɓen. Ka nǝv itar, “Kalkal ba ɗiga kwaɓ na tsud, ǝn vake ɗidud kwaɓ Fǝta Yazhigǝl bi. Wirva kwaɓ vizhinen.”
Ka ɗayakavu itar dzanak, ka sugwa itar vak dadake ndar dǝg ndǝr dǝ kwaɓen. Ki da nǝga tsin kǝ giɗengitl kǝstǝlakh.
Wirva yan, sakhkana ǝn ɗakha kǝ yanud ad vaken dǝ Vak Vizh.
Wirva yan, a righif lave tsa kwarga Rimi tlayang. Kwarne, “Ka ɓǝf itar kwaɓ dawan kulkhkǝrɗen, gane tsa kurga udakh ya Izrail kǝ pǝlapǝl ǝn tǝghǝr tsin.
Sukgwa itar vak dadak ndar dǝg ndǝr dǝ kwaɓen, ndǝkve tsa kwarakhai Yazhigǝl Dadzikan.”
A ndiɗakharwal Bilatus kǝ Yasu
Madǝv Yasu ǝn ghitsǝn tǝvuk kǝ Bilatus Gwumn, ka ndiɗarwar Gwumn kwarne, “Kha nagh shik ya Yakhudakha?” Ka nǝv Yasu tsin, “An, kalkal a kwargakh.”
Ai kwarakhga kǝ zikzikan na kǝ zil kǝsakh zǝ malanakh ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ dlam, ad lav ghaze a ǝntlarva itar, a mbǝɗa ba dǝ ghay bi.
Ka nǝv Bilatus tsin, “A tsǝna bakha daghan lavakhan na ngatlakhvuda?”
A mbǝɗa ba Yasu ad itsauɗa bi. Itsǝn tǝghǝr kǝ kitakul kǝ lavakhe a ǝntlarva itar bi. A ndawanǝf ad Gwumn char.
A ǝntlavarnǝf lav ǝmtsa kǝ Yasu
Ən te itsera kǝ sarta khwaɗga fuɗkǝs ɗitsa ɗits, a kuyala Gwumn ǝn ɓalars dadak khaip kitakul sǝgawal ǝn gud sal. Ai naghga dlamakh ad ɓǝlars ɓǝl.
Ən tǝ yanen kǝ sart, nǝg udanen ai tsaghud, a ɗǝmal ǝn gud sal, ɗakha sara Barabas.
Dzafkhai kǝ udakha, ka ndiɗatǝrwar Bilatus kwarne, “War na kur ɓǝlakurnars ɓǝla tsǝki? Yasu Barabase, nagha Yasu ai ǝn ɗakhdud dǝ Kristu khi?”
A ndiɗga Bilatus ad ndiɗa na ndǝkyan, wirva tsatsin kwarne, a bǝdu itar ad Yasu ǝn dǝv sar kǝ wirva shilga.

Uk yan fang bi, madǝv Bilatus ǝn ndzǝgan ǝn tǝ vij taka lav, ka ɓǝlanǝf nus sar ad ud dǝ lava kǝ kwararkhai kwara kwarne, “Ɗuwars ɗuwa kwar lav ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ dadake kwal khaipǝn. Wirva a mbaka dlaɗ char, ǝn tǝghǝr kina kǝ ud khan ǝn suwan.”
Tǝkǝn zikzikan na kǝ zil kǝsakh zǝ malanakh ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ dlam, shakhanǝf itar udakh kǝ kwar kwarne, ɗuwars ɗuwud Barabas, ka kǝɗguɗ Yasu.
Ka gwidǝn ndiɗatǝrwal Bilatus kǝ dzakhava udakh. “Warek ǝn tǝb tar ǝn nakur ɓǝlakurnars bǝla tsǝki?” Nǝv itara, “Barabas.”
Ka ndiɗatǝrwal Bilatus kwarne, “Ai uɗa da mana ka dǝ Yasu ai ɗakhud dǝ Kristuwi?” Nǝv itar daghana, “Khǝrtǝga khǝrtud.”
Ka ndiɗatǝrwar Bilatus kwarne, “Wirva uɗi? Uɗa dǝg bǝzane a mangini?” Ka sǝga ɗichaw kǝ udakh kwarne, “khǝrtǝga khǝrtud.”

Vazga kǝ Bilatus aghba dǝge tǝkhin kǝ mangan bi, tsugun a katlgan kwarne udakha ǝn tsikwva kǝ tsiya gadl. Ka ǝnkǝf ad yu, pargan ad dǝvakhsar ǝn tǝ vuk dzakhava udakh. Ka ni, “Na vizh ina kǝ ud ǝn kwindara bi. Ya ɗangur yan.”
Ka ngauga udakhen daghan kwarne, “Nalnǝg vizh sar ǝn kwindǝnda zǝ kwinda zarakhǝnd.”
Ka ɓǝlatǝrnars ad Barabas. Ən tǝkhal kǝ ba udakh tsin kǝ wadzaru kiɓ kǝ Yasu, ka bǝdu kǝ khǝrtga khǝrt.
A tsafanǝf Tlujiyakh ad Yasu
Ka ɓalɓa kǝ tlujiyakh Gwumna Bilatus ad Yasu da tǝ gǝlvagh Gwumn, daghan tlujiyakhe ǝn dakwalen tsuguna a tsarghǝr itar.
Sakhardo itar kadlang, ka talarǝm itar shalaraz, khulf katlang shikakh.

Mbusaga itar dzakw man tlǝks dǝ tak, barǝm itar ǝn ghǝr. Ka ba itar da khuta gulv man tlǝks ǝn dǝva kaf sar. Khala kǝ yana ka kalaga itar juguv ǝn tǝ vuk sar, ka tsafatsafa tsitar, ka nǝv itar, “Dǝg safagh da tǝ uragh, Shik ya Yakhudakh.”
Tafarava itar shaghwvai da tǝ vǝgh. Ka chawarvar itar yaghwat man tlǝksen, dlaghar khai itar kǝɗa din ǝn ghǝr tsǝgun.
Udzal tsitar ǝn tsafatsafa, ka sakhardu itar gabag man tlǝkse tsa talarǝm itar. Ka talarǝm itar katlangakh sar. Ka ɓǝlando itar ǝn tǝvuk, ka ɓala itar kǝ wirva khǝrta khǝrt.
A khǝrtava Yasu
Madǝv itar ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ dǝga, ka gamga itar zǝ ud ya Sayirin, ɗakha sara Siman. Ka barghǝr itar dǝ ndzǝɗ ad zǝɓ ufa khǝrte da khǝrtdud Yasu.
Sara da vake ǝn ɗakhud dǝ Golgot (dǝge ǝn tukuwina in, vak tlatl ghǝr).
Ən vin a bara itar yu inabi laɓan dǝ dǝg ɗekhɗekhan. Tapana tsina, ka kalwal kǝ khǝɓakhǝɓ.
Ən tǝkhal kǝ khǝrtǝga khǝrta tsitar ǝn tǝ ufa khǝrt, ka man tsats tsitar ki da taka gabagakh sar.
Ən tǝkhal kǝ yana, ka ndzakhga itar ǝn tǝ vin kǝ ufauf.
Ka tsakhga itar ad ghaza sare ǝn kwara itar, ǝn tǝ vakghǝr sar kwarne, “INA YASU, SHIK YA YAKHUDAKH.”
Khǝrtga itar tsugun ad sǝnkarakh mits ǝn tǝvǝgh kǝ Yasu. Fanga ǝn tǝ dǝva kaf tsin, yan tsuguna ǝn tǝ dǝva dleɓ sar.
Udakhe ǝn dǝgal, ka tsafatsafa itar ad Yasu, ka kaɗaghǝr itar.
Ka nǝv itar, “Khai ǝn kwarne tǝkhakha kǝ khǝtana Fǝta Yazhigǝl, ka gwiɗǝn ndǝrgakhǝn tǝ khǝna khǝkǝrɗ. Ai kata dǝ ghǝragh. Da Zǝr Yazhigǝl khǝ, sodagh sǝg ǝn tǝ ufa khǝrtan.”
Ndǝkyan tsugun kǝ zikzikan na kǝ zil kǝsakh, zǝ li tsagdu ndzikha ndzikh Mus, zǝ malanakh ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ dlam, ka tsafatsafa tsitar kwarne,
“A katgan ad yakhai, in tsuguna a piyarwal kat ghǝr sar. Shik ya Izrail bakhini? Sodagh sǝgin ǝn tǝ ufa khǝrtana tǝkhin, ka fadǝghǝro kǝnda din.
A bo dǝ ghǝr ǝn tǝ Yazhigǝl. Ai katga kata Yazhigǝlen tǝkhin, dǝn wayawayin. Wirva Zǝr Yazhigǝl ka ni.”
Ndǝkyan sǝnkarakh ai khǝrt tǝrkhai ud dagh, ghǝrtar tsuguna kwarar khai itar lav bǝzan.
Əmtsa Yasu
Ən tǝ fatsi tǝghǝr, ka khǝɗardu ngurtl ad khaya kǝsen daghan, tangw da tǝ karfi khǝkǝrɗa khakhug.
Ən tǝ kalkala karfi khǝkǝrɗa khahughen, ka tlǝkha tsin char kwarne, “Elo, Elo, lama sabaktani?” Dǝge ǝn tukuwina in, “Yazhigǝla, Yazhigǝla, a ɗukǝdai ndar kha ndikini?”
Chalǝm udakhe ǝn ghitsǝn tǝvin, tsǝna tsitar ad inen, ka nǝv itar, “Ina kǝ uda, ǝn ɗakh Ili Tlayang.”
Ən dǝvǝn dǝva, ka khwayala fang ǝn tǝb tar, ɓadǝghǝr ad zǝr ndǝma ndǝm, luɓanan ǝn yu Inabi kwarekrekan. Siɓau ǝn tǝ yaghwat, ka talaro kǝ Yasu kǝ ɗutsaɗuts.
Ka nǝv chalǝmakh, “A ɗuwaman ndan, nǝgha nǝgha kiyam ndan patak da sǝgadagh Ili da katakat.”
Ka gwidǝn Yasu ǝn tlǝkha char, ka ɗi safa tsin, ɓawala safa sar.
Ən tǝ yanen kǝ sart, lǝgwit ghay gud ai ǝn Fǝta Yazhigǝla tiɗǝm mits, tsif ǝn tǝ vak ghǝr kakh da tǝ khay. Khay tsuguna a giɗikǝfkhai, tiɗakhǝm kurakh.
Ka chaɓga ngitlakha ngwarǝf itar. Zikǝn udakh ya Yazhigǝle tsa rugana, a tsayatǝrǝfud dǝ saf.
Sakhawal itar ǝn ngitlakh tar. Ən khal kǝ tsif tsiya kǝ Yasu ǝn ngitl, ka dal itar da Wurshalim, chuwaɗaɗan kǝ dlǝmda kǝs. A mǝdlawa itar kǝ udakh zikǝn.
Nǝgha kǝ zikan kǝ tluji zǝ chalǝm tlujiyakhe ǝn uf Yasu ad mbǝɗa pǝgdǝm zǝ daghan dǝgakhe dzoghǝr, a gadzǝf itar char. Ka nǝv itar. “Zǝr Yazhigǝl ina kaɗi kaɗi.”
Nǝg chalǝm nughwaskh zikǝn tsugun ǝn vinen, ǝn vaza vaza kǝ bit. Liye tsa gatars kǝ Yasu gwil sǝgawal ǝn Galili, ǝn nǝgharu nǝgha itar.
Ən tǝb tara nǝg Maryam ǝn kǝs ya Magdal, zǝ Maryam bab Yakub zǝ Yusuvu, zǝ nus Zabadi.
Ɗule a khǝɗud Yasu
Ɓǝlga kǝ khakhug, ka sa ud ya Armati, dadak tluwadal, ɗakha sara Yusuvu. In tsuguna fura Yasu.
Ka da da vak Bilatus shik da takaɗ tluvǝgha Yasu. Ka kwara tǝrkhai Bilatus ad bara tluvǝgha Yasu tsud kǝ Yusuvu.
Ka ɓǝf Yusuvu ad tluvǝgha Yasu, mbusanǝm ǝn wilwa lapin.
Ka khǝnanan Yusuvu ǝn gitl sare tsa khuradalin ǝn khurzǝzǝ. Ka tlǝgaru ad kur zikan, ka tǝkaval.
Maryam ǝn kǝs ya Magdal, zǝ tlǝrne ai ɗakhdud dǝ Maryam ǝn ndzǝgan itar ǝn vin, ǝn vaza ger da tǝ ngitlen.
A bava udakh kǝ uf ngitla Yasu
Tǝkǝdla sar kǝ fitsa fǝtav, ka dala zikzikan na kǝ zil kǝsakh zǝ Farisakh da vak Bilatus.
Nǝv itar, “Dǝg safagh da tǝ uragh, a dzamana kǝnda ad sarte tsa dla dadak valdu udakh na dǝ saf, kwarne, ‘Fitsa khǝkǝrɗa da tsiya ka dǝ saf.’

Wirva yan, babǝg ad udakh kǝ uf ngitlen char tangw da tǝ khǝna khǝkǝrɗ. Ki khek dǝgal kǝ furakh sar da gǝl tluvǝgh sar, kwarar khai itar kǝ udakh tsugun kwarne, ‘A tsiyif ǝn ngitl.’ Ya valdu udakhe kǝ dǝg mbas, da malamala dǝ dǝg chak kǝ bǝz.”
Ka nǝv Bilatus tsitar, “Khutsamǝf tlujiyakh, dam da ufaufa ad ngitlen, khalavuwa tǝkhur.”
Ka dǝgala itar kǝ gadlara gǝma gǝma kǝ itsawar ad ngitlen, ǝn tǝ dǝva dǝ tsakhga jakva ndzǝɗa shik ǝn tǝ kur ghay ngitlen. Tsuguna ka ba itar tlujiyakh kǝ ufauf.
